thread:
nora: Quick incident: noticed invoice-preview undetected token drop for a couple legacy clients using clientlib v1. They route through edge-proxy v2 which rewrites headers.

pete: Are we seeing malformed tenant headers or lost `usage_tokens` field?

nora: Header rewrite dropped `x-canonical-request` occasionally and proxy added a fallback request_id causing counting divergence. Sample: request_id changed from `req-9a8b` to `req-9a8b-proxy` midstream.

omar: Edge-proxy injects the `proxy_suffix` for tracing; v2 had a bug where suffix wasn't idempotent. We shipped it last week.

lina: This will cause dedupe failures if upstream canonical id is mutated. We should prefer a canonical_request header and reject proxies that mutate it. Can we add a proxy-side check to preserve `x-canonical-request` or throw?

pete: Immediate fix: we can map proxy-suffixed IDs back to canonical by stripping suffix pattern `-proxy$` in ingest normalization. It's an ugly hack but low-risk hotfix.

billing-bot: noticed spike: duplicate_request_normalizations=342 in last 10m

nora: I'll open a PR for normalization strip and add a test for suffix variants. Also notify edge team to cut a v2.1 with idempotent injection rules.

omar: Also add an alert when `canonical_header_missing_rate > 0.1%` per-region.

lina: Agreed. And add to runbook: if clientlib v1 in use, reach out to customer for upgrade path; long-term we'll add header validation at proxy layer.

pete: Action items: 1) hotfix normalization (nora, 30m). 2) proxy patch (edge team, next sprint). 3) dashboard card: canonical_header_missing by region (lina, 1h). 4) customer outreach list (pm + cs, optional).

nora: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/4248 -- running canary now. Will report back in 15m.

lina: thanks.
